sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics

Players must carefully time their captures, taking into account the speed, size, and behavior of each microbe. This requires quick reflexes, good hand-eye coordination, and a deep understanding of the game's mechanics.

As players progress through the levels, the game introduces new microbes, tools, and obstacles that require players to adapt their strategy. For example, some microbes are attracted to certain colors or patterns, while others are repelled by certain substances. By understanding these behaviors, players can develop a more effective strategy and improve their chances of success.

In addition to capturing microbes, players must also manage their resources and tools. The game features a range of tools, each with its own strengths and weaknesses, that players can use to aid them in their mission.
